HOUSE OF TOBIAS PRESENTS

THRUSTLINGS

REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER ROCKET RACING

Space is hard.
Parking is harder.

A small rocket. Two friends.
A suspicious amount of gravity.

Begin your descent ↓
IN-GAME SPACECRAFT. REAL BAD IDEAS.

01 / A BRIEF WORD ABOUT GRAVITY

Falling is free.
Landing costs extra.

Point the fiery end away from the place you want to go. Add thrust. Reconsider everything.

Thread rocky caves, skim alien oceans and bring it down gently. Momentum remembers. The ground is famously unforgiving.

Easy to understand. Gloriously hard to park.

02 / RACE TWO FRIENDS. REAL TIME.

Three pilots.
One finish pad.

Race with two friends in real time. Three rockets, one landing pad. First to land safely wins. Bragging rights included.

Pick from five handcrafted spacecraft, explore strange worlds and spend your winnings on the next very sensible upgrade. Same physics. Entirely different ways to get into trouble.

Friends don’t let friends miss the pad. Usually.

03 / PRECIOUS CARGO. STRONG OPINIONS.

Your passengers
have feedback.

Stick the landing and watch your tiny passengers shuffle out, cross the bridge and take the lift home.

Give them a gentle ride: happy faces. Pull a few too many Gs: a small, furious customer-satisfaction survey.

Fuel makes you fly. It also makes you very flammable.

FINAL APPROACH / YOU LOOK MOSTLY QUALIFIED

One more landing.

Easy on the throttle.
Let’s bring everyone home.
